Inside Our Workshop

Where every figure gets made

We don't outsource a single step. Every resin figurine is sculpted, moulded, cast, hand-painted and packed in our own workshop — by sculptors and painters we've worked with for years.

Ventilated casting rooms, dust-controlled paint booths, calibrated airbrush stations, low-VOC resins. We invested in the room before we ever invested in the production line.

Made by people who love their craft

It shows in every brushstroke.

Studio Promise

Bringing characters to life

Every figure begins with a story. A concept sketch. A beloved IP. A character your fans want to hold in their hands.

We sculpt those moments into reality. Every silhouette shaped by hand, every brushstroke guided by individual artistry.

Our creations are more than toys — they are collectibles, keepsakes, and the physical form of the worlds your audience already loves.

Why Brands Choose Us

From a single mascot to a worldwide retail run

Six things we'll always say yes to.

Low MOQ

Resin runs from as few as 100 units. No giant minimums, no inflated risk for indie launches.

Free 3D Sculpting

Send a sketch, photo or brief — our in-house sculptors deliver a print-ready 3D model and physical master at no cost.

CE / EN71 / ASTM Tested

Resin, paint and packaging tested to global toy safety standards (CE, EN71, ASTM F963, REACH). Retail-ready.

Our Own Factory

We don't outsource. Sculpting, mould-making, casting, hand-painting and packaging — all under one roof for tighter QA.

On-Time Delivery

Average 35-day production from approved master. Tracked milestones — sculpt, mould, cast, paint, pack — the whole way.

Flexible Payment

30% deposit, 70% before shipment. Trade Assurance & wire transfer accepted — easy on cash flow.

RResin Factory

B2B custom resin figurine manufacturer. Sculpt, mould, cast and hand-paint — all in our own factory.
